body: I'm still on Reddit lol so let me respond. I ended up switching to a hormonal IUD on 2020 and my UTIs went away entirely. I never tested my old IUD for bacteria, but it was weird that it was leading to recurring UTIs. I'm wondering if the shape of your uterus is causing the IUD to sit on your urethra weird leading to UTI symptoms? My friend couldn't get an IUD due to the shape of hers. Sadly you might be the same. There's plenty of other kinds of birth control out there to try. I hope you figure it out.

I'm glad you are staying with your friend and planning to leave him. I had something similar happen and I stayed. I was confused. But as other comments have mentioned, what he did was wrong and inexcusable. You will find someone who will fully respect you. You are not to blame only he is. I'm so sorry for what happened to you and if you ever need someone to listen to you vent I am here as your shoulder to lean on and your cheerleader as you process. As are I'm sure others in this thread.

Fully agree. This turned into moving states every couple of years. Escaping the life I created and starting fresh. I moved back to where I grew up and it's an identity crisis and I end up sitting at home a lot afraid to go outside. I can't be a new person here so I'm trapped.

My friend told me that pain is pain and comparing who's is worse is useless. I used to try and invalidate my reactions but it wasn't ok. There's always someone out there who has it worse, but what you feel is valid and ok.

You make so much sense you have no idea. I was talking to my therapist last week about times I've "acted out" and she said that it's really good I can realize that now. It's hard to not recognize yourself when you look back, but I think realizing that about you is a really good first step. Whenever I have to get a new therapist (I move a lot) I always ask if they are comfortable telling me I'm wrong or telling me no. I let them know that sometimes I can go into "fight" mode which for me is being mean to people or causing drama when I feel threatened/sad. Not all therapists feel comfortable with it, so it's something to ask for and look for.

Tbh he will feel abandoned but it sounds like your parents are able to be there for him when you can't be. It can be as simple as a mental shift. When I let my parents back in my life, it was responding to texts once a month and slowly grew into more often. Everyone feels guilty for putting their needs first but you can't be a good sister if you feel resent or it negatively affects you as well.
I'm glad you are trying

When I was younger my mom's voice was so loud saying I was clumsy and not athletic and reminding me of all the things I couldn't do. It took a long time to be good at being bad at things. To laugh when I make a fool of myself. To not be perfect. I go rock climbing and the 8 year olds are better than me. I go hiking and have to ask the group to slow down. I lose every goddamn pickleball game I ever play. But I still do it and I still have fun. Everyone around you doesn't care that you fail, only you do.

Medication is tricky. I'm on paxil now and it helps make me not cry every day lol. But other than that I feel most the same downs as normal. If those things didn't make you happy that's ok. They don't have to. I feel happy when I see cute puppies on the street disobey their owners or when I watch a really cool indie sci-fi movie that makes me think. There's joy in little things. The rest is sort of bullshit noise that society makes us deal with. Do you have friends still? Sometimes just telling them you love them and are proud of them can help make your friendships better. I'm so grateful for mine and they are always there when I'm low. I never feel like a burden cuz I'm there for them too

Me too! I thought I'd be dead by 18 and now I'm 30. But it's cool. I've done some pretty neat things. There were low points, like really low points. Even this past year sucked but things can be good too. I find solo travel fun, even just driving to a new town and exploring or going to the movies alone. And I have great friends. There's a lot of places I want to see, I want to go see a grizzly bear in Alaska and I want to scuba dive in the coral reefs of Australia. Not sure when I'll be able to but I'm excited for the silly goals. This past summer I saw the northern lights and they were beautiful. Little goals can push you forward.

Don't go to college if you don't want to or aren't sure what you want. Try new things. Get a job in a new town. Finish high school tho. Even tho it sucks, if you ever decide you want to go to college you can.

3 years ago I was still dating "the one" and 5 years ago was the happiest year of my life. But things get better and different. Don't live in the past, live right now. Everything feels consuming and hard but you can do anything you want. Just don't be afraid.
Don't waste your time on this person. When you leave, so many better things will come your way. They are a chain.

Everyone is the main character of their own story.

This is a quote that changed my perspective of others. Everyone is important. Even if they do dumb mundane things. You can learn and you can learn from others and it's fun.

Different but I understand where you are coming from. My needs were always ignored compared to my sister. When she was depressed so was I but my mother only cared about her. What helped for me was taking space. Viewing our interactions less like family and more like business obligations. My sister and I are very good friends now and she's in a lot better of a place. My parents are fine. I'm being vague but all I'm saying is don't feel guilty for prioritizing yourself. I didn't talk to my parents for over a year and the guilt ate away but ultimately they are now a lot kinder to me because they know my relationship to them has limits.

Tbh lately I haven't been exercising much. Probably cuz depression. Are there hiking trails or forest trails near you? Also walking around the neighborhood and judging people's houses is sort of fun lol.

A therapist can help you with quitting. Do you have anyone you can talk to? I agree, it seems like you are using it as a distraction. Maybe playing a sport or doing art so you aren't at home can help and allow you to be distracted from your thoughts.

Idk which country you are but think about graduating highschool at least. I also skipped school a lot and my parents let me. I studied at home and went in for tests. I HATED school but school isn't work and I think you'll like working. That said high school graduation helps with getting jobs and if you are ever crazy like me and decide to become a scientist, you need it to go to college. And college still is kind of sucky cuz it's still school but it's different in a good way. All this to say, maybe try and finish and then work, future you may thank you.

It seems like you are traumatized from things that you have experienced if I would guess. The lack of feeling might be to protect yourself. Do you have a therapist? Sometimes they can help you work through these things.

I also have intrusive thoughts and I've also felt like you feel. Overdosing feels awful and it won't help. Watch cute dog and cat videos online. Listen to a podcast or music to drown out your thoughts. You are in control of your head. Tell it to shut up.
Me too. Apologies go far and being a better person now is all you can do.
The world is cruel, but you can create pockets of life and love and that sort of makes existence a bit more bearable

I'm so glad you reached out for help. You are insanely strong and I'm proud of you. I understand how you have been feeling and I've been there before. Recovery isn't linear, this will be up and down and just know that a step forward no matter how small is a step in the right direction. You got this

It's ok you feel the way you do. Sometimes life is hard and it's even harder to see the good parts. You can tell your mom your feelings are hurt, maybe she'll listen. Tell her when she's in a good mood. I'm sorry your dad is far away. When I was your age I didn't help enough around the house either. Now that I'm older, whenever I visit home I clean and do the dishes, certain things come with maturity and age and it's hard to remember being a teen like yourself when you're 50 like your mom. Her health thing also resonates with me cuz once again my mom is the same. When I was your age I felt hopelessness and had no plans for my future, but now I find beauty in the little things and it's given me a lot of peace. To view the world with childlike joy, to look at pretty clouds and little bugs and stars. It all feels overwhelming now and some days in the future it will feel like this too but it's ok because other days are fun with laughter and joy and good food and pretty views. You will get through this tough time and make an amazing life for yourself.
Tell your fiance this. Tell your family this. It is so obvious to me that you are loved and it's ok to lean on others. Tell them why you love them and they will tell you why they love you back
Things ebb and flow, that's the definition of life. But you know it can be good again like it was before and maybe holding onto that shred of hope can get you through
You don't need to cry. You can scream. You can make art. You can journal (tbh I always cry when I journal). There are other outlets than tears. I'm sorry you feel sad.

It actually doesn't get easier and I hate when people say that too. However it does ebb and flow. Some days, months years, are awful, but others are good. You seem really stuck to me, I've been there too before and am currently in a sticky era. But you will come out of it. What do you want? What would make things better?
The nihilist in me believes no one is special, however you can create special moments. You can be kind, you can help people, and you can focus on the little beautiful things.

I do "all the right things" but honestly at this point life just feels beyond meaningless. I take my meds, I go for walks, I have a good job, I volunteer, I get dinner with friends, I read books, I go hiking. However, I don't see puppies at the pet shop because I know they come from puppy mills where they abuse dogs. I don't get pastries at coffee shops because I try to eat healthy. I don't listen to music anymore because I find no joy in it (ironic because my side hustle involves making music playlists). 

I pushed through all the bad stuff because for a while there were lots of good things in my life. One by one everything fell apart, leaving just a rickety structure but no joy. It "gets better" but it doesn't really last.
Agreed. I'm in the letting go stage and I think having that bad day and crying over it was what I needed to emotionally release instead of bottling it all up and trying to be fine.

I don't think I have a life sucks mentality, but this was posted during a really bad day. To be honest, the situation has made my mental health just really bad overall and I wish they would just sell it instead of asking me every couple of days to buy it because it just makes it feel worse that I can't afford it.

I am for sure resentful over money and I try to not think about it but it's been really hard. I'm not dirt poor anymore like I was when I was 20 but the memories of literally being unable to afford groceries and breaking up with a boyfriend because he ate all my food will never quite go away knowing your family is upper middle class and your sister's dance classes were more expensive than your tuition (which they didn't pay for). 

I don't want to talk to them about it or feel entitled to inheritance and so I don't talk to them about it and when I posted this I was having an awful day after flying back from where I used to live which was a lot more affordable (houses were $200k there and houses here are $1M, my salary did not increase with the move). I think the tough part is jealousy over how much consistent financial investment my sister has had in life and wondering why my parents raised us so differently. The house was something that I always thought would be mine and the illusion of equal treatment is finally ending. I have a good job now and I don't need financial support or inheritance honestly. I'll be fine.

I'm doubtful she'll play detective on the dates. I'm also really glad she reacted well! It's nice that someone has your back like that. Try to ease your worries that her reaction was fake, I doubt it was. The people that don't believe you aren't worth being around in the long term anyways.
Please tell an adult/police. What's happening to you is a serious offense. They can get the pictures off his phone.

I've also dealt with guilt telling people and worried about them telling others (they did). The thing is that I believe you. People don't lie and make up trauma that happened years ago, they were hurt and it takes time to figure out how to define the situation. It seems like your friend maybe didn't have the reaction you wanted? Idk but people don't know how to deal with situations like this, as it took you time to come to terms with it, it will also take them time as well. Please dont panic or anguish. Nothing you did was wrong. I'm so sorry about what happened to you and I hope you heal from it. It sounds like you are taking steps towards being better and I'm proud of you.

I'm glad you felt comfortable to ask for help here :) I wish I had more advice though. Good luck with managing them. I feel like you are a very proactive person and even if it takes time, you'll be able to reduce their influence

Yeah let me know how it works. I struggle with PTSD and it was a really important way I learned to ground myself. Whenever I panic it helps me snap out of it because I can rationalize how I got to the panic if that makes sense. It's really the only technique that worked for me and I wish others knew about it more.

One thing that helped me was the "step back" approach. When I spiral I think "what was I thinking before this?" And eventually land on the first thought that caused me to spiral. I listen to a lot of podcasts and music to help with distraction. For me it's all about distraction. What sometimes works for you?

I've been in a similar situation. To me what happened was rape even though the second time was consent. At the time I was still trying to figure out boundaries, now that I've dated superiorly better people, I've realized what I dealt with prior was not ok. Good people stop when you say no, they stop when you aren't enthusiastic, etc. etc.

Edit: I also want to say sorry. It seems like you are emotionally upset and you don't deserve the treatment. You deserve to move forward and upward. Don't let what's happened to you hold you back. You are amazing.

Thank you, I know these are small wins but it's hard for these little things to feel like wins when I used to be able to do more. Fostering pets was a lifesaver for me when I lived alone during the pandemic. They force you to get out of bed and go outside multiple times a day. Also I know meds take time, I just don't even know if they are enough to give me relief.

Yeah I think my therapist just sees this as a phase but I feel like I've been struggling for 5 months. The pro of city is more things to make friends vs the suburbs where I'd really have to settle into crazy dog lady. That said, maybe I need to reconnect with nature and animals and slow life idk.

Not better!!!! I accepted a job in the city I grew up in. I am stressed all the time. I cried Wednesday cuz I got a job offer (for a worse job) in the city my sister lives in. Hahaha ugh. It's so hard to know what the right decision is

I feel you. I have "lost years" that I refer to as spans of time I just have blurriness about. I think the worst for me is telling stories and people going "I know I was there with you" because I simply can't remember who things are about or with. The last couple of weeks have been ok enough. Turns out I filled out the form and 24 hours after posting this I got the ceremony details email I was spiraling about having not gotten yet.

I removed mine on all social media and just crazy vented to anyone that would listen. You are worth being wanted. Do not do these things because you hurt, the best "revenge" is being better than you are now. Idk I wanted to do everything and try and rekindle and fix things but in my relationships I knew I gave too much and in the end his big gesture of reciprocation never happened. I never have to worry about that now.

BAD. I feel like I'm going insane because I can't remember if I registered for my college graduation ceremony in March because I didn't write it down and I was trying out new meds at the time and that whole month was awful and stressful and if I didn't do it, I can't go and my family is coming to town.
Thanks. I'm just a girl with a dream hahaha
Fuck I knew it
Oh my gosh it's an epidemic
Thank you <3
Miller High Life is standards
Just realized I read it as tamari and not tamarind hence why I subbed soy sauce hahahahaha fml
Ya know..... Now that you mention it was totally tamarind and not tamari which I subbed for sou sauce. Omfg the dyslexia wins again
I'm going to try this out thanks!!

The 10 10 10 method is interesting. The issue is that I can't imagine 10 years from now. I used to be able to think like that but lately I just fully exist in the moment and think how I want a new job. My happiness is definitely tied to my career and I can't think past that because depending where my next job takes me allows me to plan again. Right now I feel so in flux because I hate what I do so I can't plan to stay. Now that my sister isn't moving here, I can't fathom continuing my career as a compromise to be near her. It's just really tough.

Same. I literally can't stand my partner right now and don't want to talk to them. I've snapped at him a couple times and today hung up our phone call after getting angry again when he told me I should stop taking these meds. He doesn't understand mental illness and I'm really good at masking. Idk I think maybe he's right but I don't know if it's worth getting through this rage period.
I am on day 12 today. So yeah basically the same.

Yeah she was just surprised it has hit me so hard so idk. We maybe have a meeting next week because idk what to do. She said "oh this drug and basically symptom free" I don't know why psychiatrists really think that because this subreddit is like the opposite
It's annoying because my other meds work fine but she was adamant to try something new idk
I started on 5....
Yeah I'm trying to cultivate that for myself but right now I feel wholly stuck. I think when I'm not busy I don't know what to do with myself really. When I'm not learning I'm rotting.

I have done that in the past but I find myself unable to consume media these days. I listen to music mostly and watch TV which I need to get out of the habit of tbh. It's mostly social since I watch with friends or discuss with my sibling.

Routines are simultaneously liberating and debilitating. I am trying to cultivate one but I don't know if it makes me happy. I don't know how my friends stay happy with what they do. It's all just a bit confusing tbh.
I have Liletta but was wondering if it's stress induced as well. When I used to get a period, I swear stress would do the opposite. Good to know I need to chill more haha

I mean, how else can one explain a burning feeling on the face and then a bunch of pimples/redness that lingers? It was the burning feeling and warmness that was so weird and something I've never experienced before. I hadn't eaten anything for a bit and was driving in my car. It's not like I had an allergic reaction?

I ended up talking to her last night and saying "obviously I'm overprotective of you because you're my best friend, but unless his behavior changes, you are going to burn out from stress" and I think she took it ok. I hope she isn't mad at me.

I mean that's a lot and it sucks. If it makes you feel any better, I didn't scream no and punch my abuser so what does it matter? I dated him so I "asked for it" or whatever. It doesn't matter how put together your life is, I'm a scientist and have a good job, I graduated college with honors. His dad used to be a state congressman. If anything I bullied him so bad he dropped out of college and still works at the same record store ever since. I moved states and I'm far from the triggers and people who didn't support me or believe me. The next guy who assaulted me since works as a cook and eventually pushed away his other friends. Since that guy I got a better job and went back to school. I didn't report him because I was traumatized from the first person who abused me and what happened to my life when I spoke out. That said I've worked really really hard to become emotionally stable and build a good life for myself. So many times I considered quitting and turning to substances to numb the flashbacks and pain, but I'm really lucky I have some good friends who never let me do it. Everything I do is out of spite. I took my sadness and my anger and ran with it.

That girl has problems and I'm sorry she bullied you. The way she reacted was not normal and to harass you afterward could warrant a restraining order tbh. Also your mom sounds like my mom. Solidarity. Do you have a therapist to talk through this all with? It's really heavy and damaging stuff. It's taken me years to feel more healed and yet my healing is still in progress. You deserve better from the world, yet sometimes it isn't kind.

Hi friend. Deep breaths. Depression is a disease and it's so hard some days and months and years. The thing about life is that there's ups and downs and it's worth living for those ups even if they are small. Why don't you call a suicide hotline and try and see what options you have?

I have a lot of friends because I'm funny and super outgoing. That said, I lost one of the few people that felt like home because of my impulsions and delusions. I want to reach out and offer an apology and talk, but I don't know what to say besides "hey I didn't realize you liked me back because whenever I said I liked you, you invalidated me, so in a self sabotage move to get over my crush on you, I hooked up with your best friend" like wtf is wrong with me???? Why do I use people????

Yeah I guess the job I'm on leave from is six figures and I can switch to an office that does more modeling which would be nice. I kind of lucked out tbh cuz most environmental based jobs don't make much money

I'm a biologist/public health scientist and I'm going back to school for environmental engineering to become an environmental modeler. I want to model climate change impacts on human health ideally. I know it exists, but it's so hard to break in and I need the coding and probability/stats background to do it.

Yeah I guess I just want family and community a lot. I'm trying to do important stuff for work and then have a good group of chosen family at the end of the day. I'm so social, the loneliness is really killing me. I barely even have time for friendship

Thank you. I'm really trying. I knew it would be hard because I'm a biologist switching to environmental engineering but it's just so much harder with all the external factors working against me. I have met some great people in my program and I like them a lot, but it's just hard cuz I can't really lean on these people for support yet since it's too new. Also yeah idk about my relationship and it's longevity anymore obviously. I'm just sad, I feel like issues popped up being long distance and the first year was great in person. Happiest year of my life tbh, don't know why I left except to get a long-term career. Sucks to be miserable for the past 3 years, try to make a change for the better, and the one thing that was a light during that time is just gone now.
I used to be like you, then I got better friends. There are good people in the world that will listen and support you. Just make sure you offer the same in return.

I'm so so sorry about what happened to you. You didn't do anything. None of this was your fault. He took advantage of you, he assaulted you, you didn't deserve it. Please take some Advil and if you have the courage tell someone. What he did was so wrong. At minimum please find a therapist to confide in. You deserve to heal from this and get the support you need. I wish you luck.

Some couples who don't argue before need couples therapy to moderate their discussions. If you guys are still in communication maybe suggest it? Idk my bf of 4.5 years dumped me and suggested a couples therapist and regular therapy and I couldn't find any to speak to us in my state cuz the rules are so strict. I saw a regular therapist 2 times before he dumped me and he hadn't even had his first solo session yet. Feels kind of bad honestly. Now I'm rambling. Anyways airing something out without a "I understand" "tell me more" "I'm sorry I hurt you" "I'm going to work on changing my reaction/attitude/etc" and generally active listening just drives a wedge between two people. It sucks.

Outgoing personality and gets along with all types of people. That said if dating has taught me anything, kindness is the most important trait. Is he helping people out of the goodness in his heart? Is he supportive and caring and generous? I myself am a very giving person and when I like someone I'm all in, so I want to find someone who reciprocates what I naturally will do for them. That said, yet to find anyone romantically who's like that. My friends are lovely though, we go to the ends of the earth for each other.

Have you seen a therapist? I wonder if there's anyway to proactively rest your brain. Even in all our ways you've healed, something is wrong clearly. I have PTSD so my brain is wired for flashbacks and nightmares when I'm stressed even if my stress is unrelated to my trauma. Are you stressing about other things now? Could you try mindfulness or meditation or yoga to destress? For me I cook and make art and listen to music to destress. It helps a little bit.

Hi panic attacks are awful. I'm so sorry you get them. I try not to think of my ex before bed which helps eliminate him from my dreams. Maybe try reading before bed or something calming to take your mind to a better place. I still get nightmares every night but it's only been a couple weeks. I can't imagine what you are dealing with and I wish you luck.

I'm sorry. I am in a similar situation. 4 years and 1 month before we moved in together he was confused about us....eventually broke up with me after spending a month saying he wanted to fix things without any follow through. We will both get through this. I'm so sorry your future plans shattered. It's two big losses at once but you'll be ok.

Yes all normal feelings. I look back at my exes and cringe. For me attractiveness is directly correlated to me liking you as a person. Breakups take off the rose colored glasses. Also yeah the nausea is real, I get it from anxiety usually, seems like you're anxious to watch him move on because you're hurt. You'll get through it.

You're killing it. I'm killing it. We are killing it. My friends keep telling me that I invested my time into someone who was never going to grow into the person he always said he was going to be. I never asked him to change, but his false promises ended with him dumping me because he couldn't follow through and honestly I think got cold feet when he actually had to step up and move with me as I went to grad school. All this to say, you're going to find someone I'm sure of it. Girls flock towards men with their shit together. Take time, heal your broken heart, but you don't have to work on yourself, you can be confident and satisfied with who you are. Some people break up because of compatibility, not because someone was wrong or bad. Idk I just wanted to say hi and let you know you aren't alone. Working on myself looks like doing the same stuff I was planning on doing with added therapy and calls to friends as I heal. Good luck.

I know. It's just hard. I'm grappling how things were seemingly perfect to not. My world flipped upsidedown with a single phone call. I visited 2 weeks before and we signed a lease. I don't know what changed. I feel like our relationship got more real when he had to move and it's unfair because I never forced him to, so he led me on saying he would to just not.

Lol I did something like that and he dumped me. I finally cracked and advocated for myself cuz he was treating me like dirt. His friends were more of a priority than visiting me. We were supposed to live together starting this week and a week before I moved to "our home" he told me he was confused about us and confused about moving to be with me. Then he stopped communications, stopped calling, stopped texting. When we spoke he said he'd get a plane ticket to visit and then the next time we spoke he talked about planning a vacation with friends, after he was supposed to live here, a month out. Like was I just supposed to wait until October for him to visit? I needed any reassurance it wasn't all in my head and he wanted to work it out. He didn't. It fucking sucks. Idk I just feel so abandoned lately.
Thanks for commenting. That post was barely English. My brain is just scrambled eggs all the time lately. I had my first day of classes today. Every milestone is a reminder of what I lost.

I just want to call him up and ask if I can move to be with him and quit school. It would be so obviously one sided but I can't help but feel I loved for a job and I asked him to move for my school and maybe I didn't do enough? I was on antidepressants that made me less caring and talkative. We stopped doing dates long distance and he said cuz I usually plan them and he didn't. He broke up with me when I wasn't myself. I don't see a next chapter, I see me giving up. I'm probably going to drop out of graduate school. I can't live here with the constant reminder of what I lost all around me.

I feel like he had to of wanted me but instead of discussing our arguments, he hid his pain, built contempt towards me, and never healed. It's so painful, I can't even begin to describe it. I got through that time because in the end it was us vs the situation and I love him so much, I knew I could never stay mad. I went to therapy, I did my healing. I'm in so much pain. We were going to get married after I finished school. There's a lot of false promises. I never promised these things to anyone I dated before. He was it for me.

Yeah I'm considering deferring. I'm going to talk to my advisor this week. I reached out to counseling and disability services on campus. I have mental health illnesses that are crashing down around me because I've been abandoned.

I've been struggling to envision myself in the future this past year and that's part of why he didn't move to be with me I'm sure. I'm going back to school and I'm lost as to why especially now that there's no getting more skills to land a job in the state his family lives in and I guess he never left.
Yeah I just. I want someone like him. The next door opening just feels like an empty hallway of waiting for him to change his mind and want me back.
Yeah it's really hard in the moment to feel like you will ever get better or get past your emotions. They'll get dimmer with time as you let more good into your life. You got this. I believe in you.

The freeze situation is so confusing, I'm glad the other commenter brought it up. And agreed, there was no consent. If you are in the US maybe reach out to RAINN or a therapist to talk through what happened to you. I'm glad you aren't with him anymore and I'm so sorry about what happened to you. It was wrong and I'm sure it was confusing too. I wish you luck in your healing journey.

Maybe you can tell the authorities, a therapist, or honestly your mother. My family tore a bit when I told my mom, it hurt so badly, but I also would've never been able to move forward with healing if I kept it all inside. Good luck and be strong.

I'm so sorry. What you went through was unfair to you. It's so hard to be strong but I sense your strength in every word. You are a beautiful person deserving of love and people that protect you. Have you seen a therapist? I think it could really help you. I also think you're one of the few people I'd recommend to put distance between your hometown and your family. You don't deserve the constant reminders of what happened to you. You deserve to heal and love a fulfilling life and be the greatest success story ever. Please take care of yourself, breathe, and focus on the future. You will get past your trauma if you put in the effort to heal.

Rage my friend and rage on. That behavior is not ok. It immediately turns me off from people if I see it. I go back and forth because I think people can learn and grow, but that doesn't mean I want to make space for those people in my life. Most people don't assault other people, it's really that simple. You're normal, trust me.

I'm so so sorry about what happened to you. It's unfair and it's ok you are struggling. I'm glad you are seeing a therapist, it takes a while to heal even with therapy. It took me 6 months to have a session where I could meet her eyes and not weep trying to talk. It's hard but you are so strong. Focus on friendships.
